```{r packages}
library(sparkline)
library(htmltools)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(wehoop)
library(ggrepel)
library(reactable)
library(purrr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
# required by wehoop: pre-2024 season .rds files store their columns as arrow
# ALTREP vectors, which readRDS silently returns as length-zero vectors (and
# rbindlist then pads to NA) unless arrow is loaded
library(arrow)
```

```{r data}
this_year <- as.integer(year(now()))

seasons <- c(2004:as.integer(this_year))

# Load the configuration
config <- config::get()

# get data based on the configuration

if (config$data_source == "local") {
    dat <- readRDS("dat.rds")
    sched <- readRDS("sched.rds")
}
  
if (config$data_source == "wehoop") {
    dat <- load_wnba_player_box(seasons = seasons)
    sched <- wehoop::load_wnba_schedule(seasons = seasons)
}

sched_games <- sched |> 
  select(game_id, game_date, season_type, type_id, type_abbreviation,
  home_display_name, home_score, away_display_name, away_score, attendance) |> 
    mutate(attendance = as.integer(attendance))

# game types
game_types <- sched_games |> 
  select(game_id, type_id, type_abbreviation)

# reguarl season games excluding CC and Allstar games
rs_game_ids <- sched_games |> 
  select(game_id, type_id) |> 
  filter(type_id == 1)

# postseason games
ps_games_ids <- sched_games |> 
  select(game_id, type_id) |> 
  filter(type_id %in% c(14, 16, 17))

athletes <- dat |>
  select(athlete_id, athlete_display_name)

# Drop All-Star exhibition rosters, which are not real teams. This used to be
# `filter(team_id < 90)`, back when every franchise had a two-digit id and only
# the exhibition rosters did not. ESPN now issues six-digit ids to new
# franchises too, so that test also removed Golden State, Toronto and Portland.
# Exclude the exhibitions by game type instead, which is what was always meant.
dat <- dat |>
  left_join(game_types, by = "game_id") |>
  filter(type_id != 4) |>
  # Drop players who dressed but did not play. ESPN carries a row per rostered
  # player per game; the inactive ones have no minutes and no stats, but they
  # still inflate every n_distinct(game_id) used as a games-played denominator.
  # That is what put this dashboard's per-game averages under ESPN's -- Caitlin
  # Clark sat 3 games, which read as 19.3 ppg here against ESPN's 21.5.
  #
  # The `did_not_play` flag only became reliable in 2013. Before that, 10-22%
  # of rows per season are inactive players it never marked; they show up as a
  # row with no minutes and every stat column NA. `!is.na(points)` catches
  # exactly those 7,654 rows and nothing else -- of 102,076 rows that do carry
  # minutes, not one is blank across all thirteen stat columns.
  #
  # Together these keep "one row = one game actually played" true downstream.
  filter(!(did_not_play %in% TRUE), !is.na(points))

games <- dat |>
  filter(season == this_year) |>
  summarise(
    team_1 = first(team_display_name),
    team_2 = first(opponent_team_display_name),
    .by = c(game_id, game_date)
  ) |> 
    arrange(desc(game_date))

# max number of games this year for any team
num_games <-dat |>
  filter(
    season == this_year,
    type_id == 1
    ) |>
  select(team_display_name, game_id, game_date) |>
  unique() |> 
  arrange(team_display_name, desc(game_date)) |> 
  count(team_display_name, sort = TRUE) |> 
  head(1) |>
  pull(n)

```

```{r freshness}
#| output: asis

# The dashboard is rendered and published by hand, so it carries no other
# signal of how current it is. Report both dates: the render date alone would
# imply the data is as fresh as the render, which it is not.

fmt_date <- function(d) {
  d <- as.Date(d)
  paste0(format(d, "%b"), " ", as.integer(format(d, "%d")), ", ", format(d, "%Y"))
}

freshness_stamp <- paste0(
  "Data through ", fmt_date(max(dat$game_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
  "  ·  Rendered ", fmt_date(Sys.Date())
)

# The navbar is built by Quarto after this chunk runs, so append to it on load.
# The tab list carries Bootstrap's `me-auto`, which right-aligns any sibling
# placed after it.
cat(sprintf(
  '<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var nav = document.querySelector("#dashboard-collapse");
  if (!nav) return;
  var stamp = document.createElement("span");
  stamp.className = "navbar-stamp";
  stamp.textContent = "%s";
  nav.appendChild(stamp);
});
</script>',
  freshness_stamp
))
```

```{r funcs1}
post_season_ids <- c(14, 16, 17)

player_stats <- function(
  data, season_part = c("regular", "post"), my_season = NULL
  ) {
  
  # stop if no type_id column
  stopifnot("type_id" %in% names(data))

  season_part <- match.arg(season_part)

  my_type_id <- as.integer(1)

  if (season_part == "post") {
    my_type_id <- post_season_ids
  }

  result <- data |> 
    filter(
      !is.na(athlete_display_name),
      type_id %in% my_type_id
      )

  if (!is.null(my_season)) {
    result <- result |> 
      filter(season == my_season)
  }
  
  types <- result$type_id |> unique()

  result <- result |>
    replace_na(list(points = 0)) |>
    summarise(
      position = paste(
        unique(athlete_position_name),
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      total_games = if_else(
        nchar(n_distinct(game_id, na.rm = TRUE)) == 1,
        as.integer(paste0("0", n_distinct(game_id, na.rm = TRUE))),
        as.integer((n_distinct(game_id, na.rm = TRUE)))
      ),
      total_seasons = if_else(
        !is.null(my_season),
        1,
        as.integer(n_distinct(season, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      seasons = if_else(
        n_distinct(season, na.rm = TRUE) != 1,
        paste(range(season, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = "-"),
        as.character(range(season, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = "-")[[1]]
      ),
      latest_team = last(team_display_name),
      total_points = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE),
      ppg = list(points), # list for sparkline plots in table rows
      goals_made = sum(field_goals_made, na.rm = TRUE),
      threes_made = sum(three_point_field_goals_made, na.rm = TRUE),
      frees_made = sum(free_throws_made, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_assists = sum(assists, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_rebounds = sum(rebounds, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_steals = sum(steals, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_blocks = sum(blocks, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_turnovers = sum(turnovers, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_fouls = sum(fouls, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_ejections = sum(ejected, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = athlete_display_name
    ) |>
    rename(
      athlete = athlete_display_name
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total_points))

  if (!is.null(my_season)) {
    result |>
      select(-total_seasons)
  } else {
    result
  }
}

# player points per season over entire career
player_pps <- function(data, my_type_id = 1) {

  data |>
    filter(type_id == my_type_id) |>
    replace_na(list(points = 0)) |>
    summarise(
      points = as.integer(sum(points, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .by = c(athlete_display_name, season)
    ) |>
    arrange(athlete_display_name, season)
}
```

```{r funcs2}
player_doubles <- function(data, my_type_id = 1, my_season = NULL) {
  dat <- data |>
    filter(type_id == my_type_id)

  if (!is.null(my_season)) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(season == my_season)
  }

  dat |>
    select(
      athlete = athlete_display_name,
      game_id,
      points,
      rebounds,
      assists,
      steals,
      blocks
    ) |>
    mutate(game_id = as.character(game_id)) |>
    arrange(game_id) |>
    mutate(
      across(
        points:blocks,
        \(x) if_else(is.na(x) | x < 10, FALSE, TRUE)
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      doubles = as.integer(
        rowSums(
          pick(where(
            ~ is.logical(.x)
          ))
        )
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      doubles_type = case_when(
        doubles == 2 ~ "double_double",
        doubles == 3 ~ "triple_double",
        doubles == 4 ~ "quadruple_double",
        doubles == 5 ~ "quintuple_double",
        .default = "other"
      )
    ) |>
    select(game_id, athlete, doubles_type) |>
    count(athlete, doubles_type) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = doubles_type,
      values_from = n
    ) |>
    replace_na(
      list(double_double = 0, triple_double = 0)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      double_double = if_else(
        triple_double > 0, double_double + triple_double, double_double
      )
    ) |>
    select(athlete, triple_double, double_double)
}
```

```{r funcs3}

stat <- function(data, col, ...) {
  if (n_distinct(data$seasons) > 1) {
    data |>
      select(athlete, {{ col }}, total_seasons, seasons) |>
      arrange(desc(.data[[col]])) |>
      slice(1:150) |>
      mutate(rank = row_number()) |>
      select(rank, athlete, {{ col }}, total_seasons, seasons)
  } else if (n_distinct(data$seasons) == 1) {
    data |>
      select(athlete, {{ col }}, seasons) |>
      arrange(desc(.data[[col]])) |>
      slice(1:150) |>
      mutate(rank = row_number()) |>
      select(rank, athlete, {{ col }}, seasons)
  }
}
```

```{r helpers}
# ESPN serves headshots at 350px -- 290 KB each -- and crests at 500px, for
# pictures this page draws at 110px and 26px. Its own combiner endpoint resizes
# on the CDN and returns the same face at 13 KB. Nothing inlines these, so the
# full-size versions were a live request per player on every view.
# The combiner resizes to exactly the width and height asked for, without
# preserving aspect: a 600x436 headshot requested at 120x120 comes back
# squashed, which stretched every face in the comparison table. Ask for a width
# only and let it scale proportionally, or pass a height that matches the
# source's own ratio. CSS `object-fit: cover` does any cropping from there.
espn_img <- function(url, w, h = NULL) {
  path <- str_replace(url, "^https?://[a-z0-9.]+", "")
  size <- paste0("&w=", w, if (!is.null(h)) paste0("&h=", h))
  if_else(is.na(url), NA_character_, paste0(
    "https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=", path, size
  ))
}

# ESPN's brand colours are picked for white backgrounds, so several of them --
# Dallas navy, Indiana navy, Seattle green -- disappear against a dark page.
# Lift value and saturation to a floor so every franchise still reads as itself.
accent <- function(hex) {
  hex <- ifelse(is.na(hex) | hex == "", "f57b20", hex)
  map_chr(hex, function(h) {
    hsv_cols <- rgb2hsv(col2rgb(paste0("#", h)))
    v <- max(hsv_cols[3, 1], 0.62)
    s <- if (hsv_cols[2, 1] < 0.06) 0 else max(hsv_cols[2, 1], 0.42)
    hsv(hsv_cols[1, 1], s, v)
  })
}

pct_of <- function(made, att) if_else(att > 0, 100 * made / att, NA_real_)

fmt1 <- function(x) if_else(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.1f", x), "—")
fmt_pct <- function(x) if_else(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.1f%%", x), "—")

short_date <- function(d) {
  d <- as.Date(d)
  paste0(format(d, "%b"), " ", as.integer(format(d, "%d")))
}
```

```{r dataprep}

pps <- dat |>
  player_pps() |>
  arrange(athlete_display_name, season) |>
  summarise(
    pps = list(points),
    .by = athlete_display_name
  )

pdat <- player_stats(data = dat, season_part = "regular")

player_seasons <- pdat |>
  select(athlete, total_games, total_seasons, seasons) |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.double),
      as.integer
    )
  )

doubles <- dat |>
  player_doubles()

main_stats <- pdat |>
  select(
    athlete,
    total_points,
    # total_assists,
    # total_rebounds,
    # total_steals,
    # total_blocks,
    position,
    latest_team
  )

doubles <- doubles |>
  left_join(main_stats, by = join_by(athlete)) |>
  left_join(pps, by = join_by(athlete == athlete_display_name)) |>
  left_join(
    player_seasons,
    by = join_by(athlete)
  ) |>
  mutate(rookie = if_else(seasons == year(now()), "rookie", ""))  |> 
  arrange(desc(total_points)) |>
  select(athlete, rookie, triple_double, double_double, total_points, pps, everything())

# kept as a plain frame under its own name: the career panel behind an expanded
# row reads from it, and a SharedData wrapper has no columns to read
doubles_df <- doubles

doubles <- SharedData$new(doubles_df, group = "experience", key = ~athlete)
```

```{r comparedata}
# per-game and percentage stats for the player comparison table;
# not a SharedData - selection drives column visibility via the JS below
compare_raw <- dat |>
  filter(
    season == this_year,
    type_id == 1,
    !is.na(athlete_display_name)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    # 120px for a 60px slot, so the portrait stays sharp on a retina screen
    headshot = espn_img(
      first(athlete_headshot_href[!is.na(athlete_headshot_href)]), 120
    ),
    # nickname rather than the full display name: it has to read under a 60px
    # photo, where "Golden State Valkyries" wraps to three lines
    team = team_name[which.max(game_date)],
    games = n_distinct(game_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_points = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE),
    ppg = total_points / games,
    apg = sum(assists, na.rm = TRUE) / games,
    rpg = sum(rebounds, na.rm = TRUE) / games,
    spg = sum(steals, na.rm = TRUE) / games,
    bpg = sum(blocks, na.rm = TRUE) / games,
    topg = sum(turnovers, na.rm = TRUE) / games,
    fg_pct = 100 * sum(field_goals_made, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(field_goals_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    tp_pct = 100 * sum(three_point_field_goals_made, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(three_point_field_goals_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    ft_pct = 100 * sum(free_throws_made, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(free_throws_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    fta = sum(free_throws_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = athlete_display_name
  )

photo_cell <- function(url, team) {
  portrait <- if_else(
    is.na(url),
    '<div style="width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:#232732;margin:0 auto;"></div>',
    paste0(
      '<img src="', url, '" width="60" height="60" alt="" ',
      'style="width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#232732;" loading="lazy">'
    )
  )

  paste0(
    '<div class="compare-photo">',
    portrait,
    '<div class="compare-team">', coalesce(team, "&mdash;"), '</div>',
    "</div>"
  )
}

# column order is fixed at render time, so arranging by ppg here keeps any
# selection of columns sorted left-to-right by descending points per game
compare_wide <- compare_raw |>
  arrange(desc(ppg)) |>
  transmute(
    athlete = athlete_display_name,
    Photo = photo_cell(headshot, team),
    `Points / Game` = fmt1(ppg),
    `Assists / Game` = fmt1(apg),
    `Rebounds / Game` = fmt1(rpg),
    `Steals / Game` = fmt1(spg),
    `Blocks / Game` = fmt1(bpg),
    `Turnovers / Game` = fmt1(topg),
    `FG%` = fmt_pct(fg_pct),
    `3P%` = fmt_pct(tp_pct),
    `FT%` = fmt_pct(ft_pct),
    `FT Attempted` = as.character(fta)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-athlete, names_to = "stat", values_to = "value") |>
  # the headshots need no row label; "Photo" only stated the obvious. The name
  # has to survive as a column above so pivot_longer has something to key on.
  mutate(stat = if_else(stat == "Photo", "", stat)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = athlete, values_from = value)

compare_players <- setdiff(names(compare_wide), "stat")

compare_top10 <- compare_raw |>
  arrange(desc(total_points)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  pull(athlete_display_name)

# crosstalk selection keys are athlete names, which are exactly the
# compare-table column ids, so no key-to-column mapping is needed
compare_js <- paste0(
  "(function() {\n",
  "  var players = ", jsonlite::toJSON(compare_players), ";\n",
  "  var top10 = ", jsonlite::toJSON(compare_top10), ";\n",
  "  var clearBtns = [];\n",
  "  function apply(keys) {\n",
  "    var shown = (keys && keys.length) ? keys : top10;\n",
  "    var hidden = players.filter(function(p) { return shown.indexOf(p) === -1; });\n",
  "    if (window.Reactable) { Reactable.setHiddenColumns('compare-table', hidden); }\n",
  "  }\n",
  "  // A selection filters every page, so picking someone who has no season on\n",
  "  // the page you switch to leaves that page with no row to untick -- e.g.\n",
  "  // Sue Bird, last season 2022, empties the current-year page completely.\n",
  "  // The way out therefore has to sit outside the table, in its card header,\n",
  "  // and on both pages, since either one can be the page left empty.\n",
  "  function showClear(active) {\n",
  "    clearBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.hidden = !active; });\n",
  "  }\n",
  "  function buildClear(handle) {\n",
  "    return ['main-table', 'all-time-table'].map(function(id) {\n",
  "      var tbl = document.getElementById(id);\n",
  "      var header = tbl && tbl.closest('.card')\n",
  "        ? tbl.closest('.card').querySelector('.card-header')\n",
  "        : null;\n",
  "      if (!header) { return null; }\n",
  "      var btn = document.createElement('button');\n",
  "      btn.type = 'button';\n",
  "      btn.className = 'card-clear';\n",
  "      btn.textContent = '\\u2715 Clear selection';\n",
  "      btn.hidden = true;\n",
  "      btn.addEventListener('click', function() { handle.set(null); });\n",
  "      header.appendChild(btn);\n",
  "      return btn;\n",
  "    }).filter(Boolean);\n",
  "  }\n",
  "  window.addEventListener('load', function() {\n",
  "    var handle = new crosstalk.SelectionHandle('experience');\n",
  "    clearBtns = buildClear(handle);\n",
  "    handle.on('change', function(e) {\n",
  "      // deselecting the last row broadcasts [] , which plotly renders as\n",
  "      // all-dimmed; plotly restores full opacity only on a strict null\n",
  "      if (e.value && e.value.length === 0) { handle.set(null); return; }\n",
  "      apply(e.value);\n",
  "      showClear(!!(e.value && e.value.length));\n",
  "    });\n",
  "    apply(handle.value);\n",
  "    showClear(!!(handle.value && handle.value.length));\n",
  "  });\n",
  "})();"
)
```

```{r profiles}
# One row per player this season, carrying everything the panel behind an
# expanded table row shows. The tables themselves stay as they were; this is
# the detail that used to have nowhere to live.
season_box <- dat |>
  filter(season == this_year, type_id == 1, !is.na(athlete_display_name))

profile <- season_box |>
  summarise(
    shot = espn_img(first(na.omit(athlete_headshot_href)), 220),
    logo = espn_img(last(na.omit(team_logo)), 52),
    color = accent(team_color[which.max(game_date)]),
    team = team_display_name[which.max(game_date)],
    pos = first(na.omit(athlete_position_abbreviation)),
    jersey = first(na.omit(athlete_jersey)),
    g = n_distinct(game_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    mins = sum(minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    pts = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE),
    reb = sum(rebounds, na.rm = TRUE),
    ast = sum(assists, na.rm = TRUE),
    stl = sum(steals, na.rm = TRUE),
    blk = sum(blocks, na.rm = TRUE),
    fgm = sum(field_goals_made, na.rm = TRUE),
    fga = sum(field_goals_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    tpm = sum(three_point_field_goals_made, na.rm = TRUE),
    tpa = sum(three_point_field_goals_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    ftm = sum(free_throws_made, na.rm = TRUE),
    fta = sum(free_throws_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = athlete_display_name
  ) |>
  rename(athlete = athlete_display_name) |>
  mutate(
    mpg = mins / g, ppg = pts / g, rpg = reb / g,
    apg = ast / g, spg = stl / g, bpg = blk / g,
    fgp = pct_of(fgm, fga), tpp = pct_of(tpm, tpa), ftp = pct_of(ftm, fta),
    # counts a three as three points and includes free throws, so it measures
    # efficiency across every kind of shot. The 0.44 estimates how many free
    # throws end a possession.
    ts = pct_of(pts, 2 * (fga + 0.44 * fta))
  )

# one bar per game actually played, in date order
game_log <- season_box |>
  arrange(athlete_display_name, game_date) |>
  transmute(
    athlete = athlete_display_name,
    d = short_date(game_date),
    opp = opponent_team_abbreviation,
    p = as.integer(replace_na(points, 0)),
    won = team_winner %in% TRUE
  ) |>
  nest(log = c(d, opp, p, won))

profile <- profile |> left_join(game_log, by = "athlete")

# indexed by name, so the panel builder is a lookup rather than a filter
profile_by <- split(profile, profile$athlete)

# the athlete's name behind her franchise's crest, so a table of names is also
# a table of teams without spending a column on it
crest_cell <- function(name) {
  p <- profile_by[[name]]
  logo <- if (is.null(p) || is.na(p$logo)) NULL else {
    tags$img(
      src = p$logo, alt = "", width = 18, height = 18, loading = "lazy",
      style = "flex:0 0 18px;object-fit:contain"
    )
  }
  div(
    style = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px",
    logo,
    span(style = "white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis", name)
  )
}

stat_cell <- function(k, v, lead = FALSE) {
  div(
    class = "dsr-stat",
    span(class = "dsr-k", k),
    span(class = if (lead) "dsr-v lead" else "dsr-v", v)
  )
}

# The panel Quarto opens under an expanded row. Built with htmltools rather
# than pasted strings, so the markup cannot come out unbalanced.
dossier <- function(name) {
  p <- profile_by[[name]]
  if (is.null(p)) {
    return(div(class = "dossier", div(class = "dsr-body", "No games this season.")))
  }

  gl <- p$log[[1]]
  top <- max(gl$p, 1)
  bars <- pmap(
    list(gl$p, gl$won, gl$d, gl$opp),
    \(p_, won_, d_, o_) div(
      class = if (won_) "dsr-bar won" else "dsr-bar",
      style = paste0("height:", max(round(100 * p_ / top), 3), "%"),
      title = paste0(d_, " vs ", o_, ": ", p_, " pts", if (won_) " (W)" else " (L)")
    )
  )

  div(
    class = "dossier",
    style = paste0("--team:", p$color),
    div(
      class = "dsr-id",
      if (is.na(p$shot)) NULL else tags$img(class = "dsr-shot", src = p$shot, alt = "", loading = "lazy"),
      div(class = "dsr-name", name),
      div(
        class = "dsr-meta",
        paste(
          c(if (!is.na(p$jersey)) paste0("#", p$jersey), p$pos, p$team),
          collapse = " · "
        )
      )
    ),
    div(
      class = "dsr-body",
      div(
        class = "dsr-grid",
        stat_cell("Games", p$g),
        stat_cell("Min/G", fmt1(p$mpg)),
        stat_cell("Pts/G", fmt1(p$ppg), lead = TRUE),
        stat_cell("Reb/G", fmt1(p$rpg)),
        stat_cell("Ast/G", fmt1(p$apg)),
        stat_cell("Stl/G", fmt1(p$spg)),
        stat_cell("Blk/G", fmt1(p$bpg)),
        stat_cell("FG%", fmt_pct(p$fgp)),
        stat_cell("3P%", fmt_pct(p$tpp)),
        stat_cell("FT%", fmt_pct(p$ftp)),
        stat_cell("TS%", fmt_pct(p$ts))
      ),
      div(
        class = "dsr-logtitle",
        paste0("Points, game by game — ", nrow(gl),
               " played, best ", top, ". Solid bars are wins.")
      ),
      div(class = "dsr-log", bars)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r career-panel}
# The All Time table's panel. Career totals come from `pdat`, and the bars are
# `pps` -- points per season -- which was already computed for a sparkline and
# is reused here at a size worth reading.
career_by <- split(pdat, pdat$athlete)
pps_by <- split(pps, pps$athlete_display_name)

career_dossier <- function(name) {
  c_ <- career_by[[name]]
  if (is.null(c_)) {
    return(div(class = "dossier", div(class = "dsr-body", "No regular-season games.")))
  }

  # active players get their current crest and portrait; everyone else has none
  # in this data, and an empty slot is better than another player's face
  p <- profile_by[[name]]
  seasons_pts <- pps_by[[name]]$pps[[1]]
  top <- max(seasons_pts, 1)
  span_years <- as.integer(str_split_1(paste0(c_$seasons, "-", c_$seasons), "-")[1])

  bars <- imap(
    seasons_pts,
    \(v, i) div(
      class = "dsr-bar won",
      style = paste0("height:", max(round(100 * v / top), 3), "%"),
      title = paste0(span_years + i - 1, ": ", v, " pts")
    )
  )

  div(
    class = "dossier",
    style = paste0("--team:", if (is.null(p)) "#f57b20" else p$color),
    div(
      class = "dsr-id",
      if (is.null(p) || is.na(p$shot)) NULL else {
        tags$img(class = "dsr-shot", src = p$shot, alt = "", loading = "lazy")
      },
      div(class = "dsr-name", name),
      div(class = "dsr-meta", paste(c_$seasons, "·", c_$latest_team))
    ),
    div(
      class = "dsr-body",
      div(
        class = "dsr-grid",
        stat_cell("Seasons", c_$total_seasons),
        stat_cell("Games", format(c_$total_games, big.mark = ",")),
        stat_cell("Points", format(c_$total_points, big.mark = ","), lead = TRUE),
        stat_cell("Pts/G", fmt1(c_$total_points / c_$total_games)),
        stat_cell("Rebounds", format(c_$total_rebounds, big.mark = ",")),
        stat_cell("Assists", format(c_$total_assists, big.mark = ",")),
        stat_cell("Steals", format(c_$total_steals, big.mark = ",")),
        stat_cell("Blocks", format(c_$total_blocks, big.mark = ",")),
        stat_cell("Threes", format(c_$threes_made, big.mark = ",")),
        stat_cell("Turnovers", format(c_$total_turnovers, big.mark = ","))
      ),
      div(
        class = "dsr-logtitle",
        paste0("Points by season, best ", format(top, big.mark = ","))
      ),
      div(class = "dsr-log", bars)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r standings-prep}
# `sched.rds` has been loaded on every render and never displayed. One card per
# franchise: record, points for and against, and the last ten results.
team_games <- season_box |>
  distinct(game_id, game_date, team_abbreviation, team_display_name,
           team_color, team_logo, team_winner, team_score, opponent_team_score)

standings <- team_games |>
  arrange(game_date) |>
  summarise(
    name = last(team_display_name),
    color = accent(last(team_color)),
    logo = espn_img(last(team_logo), 52),
    w = sum(team_winner %in% TRUE),
    l = sum(team_winner %in% FALSE),
    pf = mean(team_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    pa = mean(opponent_team_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    form = list(tail(if_else(team_winner %in% TRUE, "w", "l"), 10)),
    .by = team_abbreviation
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(w / (w + l)), desc(w))
```

```{r race-prep}
# cumulative points by game date for the scoring race chart
race <- dat |>
  filter(
    season == this_year,
    type_id == 1,
    !is.na(athlete_display_name)
  ) |>
  select(athlete_display_name, game_date, points) |>
  mutate(game_date = as_date(game_date)) |>
  arrange(game_date) |>
  mutate(
    cum_points = cumsum(replace_na(points, 0)),
    .by = athlete_display_name
  ) |>
  rename(athlete = athlete_display_name) |>
  SharedData$new(group = "experience", key = ~athlete)
```

```{r efficiency-prep}
# true shooting percentage vs shot volume for the efficiency chart;
# floor of 50 field goal attempts keeps tiny-sample players out
efficiency <- dat |>
  filter(
    season == this_year,
    type_id == 1,
    !is.na(athlete_display_name)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_games = n_distinct(game_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    fga = sum(field_goals_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    fta = sum(free_throws_attempted, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_points = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = athlete_display_name
  ) |>
  filter(fga >= 50) |>
  mutate(
    fga_per_game = round(fga / n_games, 1),
    ts_pct = round(100 * n_points / (2 * (fga + 0.44 * fta)), 1)
  ) |>
  rename(athlete = athlete_display_name) |>
  SharedData$new(group = "experience", key = ~athlete)
```

```{r experience-prep}

# named to avoid shadowing the `seasons` season-range vector defined above.
# The type_id filter matters: this plot's y axis reads "Regular Season Games
# Played", but without it playoff and Commissioner's Cup games were counted
# too, overstating 235 careers by as much as 58 games.
experience <- dat |>
  filter(type_id == 1) |>
  summarise(
    n_seasons = n_distinct(season, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_games = n_distinct(game_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(athlete_display_name)
  ) |>
  arrange(n_seasons) |>
  rename(athlete = athlete_display_name) |>
  drop_na(athlete)

# longest career in the data, used to size the experience plot x axis
max_seasons <- max(experience$n_seasons, na.rm = TRUE)

player_experience <- experience |>
  SharedData$new(group = "experience", key = ~athlete)

points <- dat |> 
  filter(
    season == as.integer(year(now())),
    type_id == 1
    ) |>
  summarise(
    n_games = n_distinct(game_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_points = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(athlete_display_name)
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(n_games)) |> 
  rename(athlete = athlete_display_name) |> 
  drop_na(athlete) |> 
  SharedData$new(group = "experience", key = ~athlete)

```

```{r sizes}
# max width for columns in reactables
sm <- 50
md <- 70
lg <- 110
```

```{r tableoptions}
# One palette, matching the tokens in styles.scss. The dashboard used to carry
# three unrelated table skins -- orange, black and tan -- which made two tables
# side by side look like two different documents.
ink <- "#101318"
panel <- "#171a21"
panel_2 <- "#1c2029"
panel_3 <- "#232732"
line <- "#2c313c"
bone <- "#ded8cb"
mute <- "#969ea9"
wnba_orange <- "#f57b20"
wnba_black <- ink
wnba_tan <- bone

court_ratio <- 1/1.88

court_theme <- reactableTheme(
  color = bone,
  backgroundColor = panel,
  borderColor = line,
  stripedColor = panel_2,
  highlightColor = panel_3,
  cellPadding = "4px 6px",
  headerStyle = list(color = mute, borderColor = line),
  rowSelectedStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = panel_3,
    boxShadow = paste0("inset 3px 0 0 ", wnba_orange)
  ),
  inputStyle = list(backgroundColor = panel_2, color = bone, borderColor = line),
  selectStyle = list(backgroundColor = panel_2, color = bone),
  pageButtonHoverStyle = list(backgroundColor = panel_3),
  pageButtonActiveStyle = list(backgroundColor = panel_3, color = wnba_orange)
)

# The four charts repeated the same fifteen lines of theme. One object, added
# to each plot, so a change lands everywhere at once.
court_gg <- theme_light() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(color = bone),
    axis.text = element_text(color = mute),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, color = mute),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # ggplotly turns panel.border into a layout shape and renders its `fill =
    # NA` as opaque white, which put a white rectangle behind every chart the
    # moment the page went dark. theme_light() sets that border, and the
    # panel.background override below never reached it. An explicit transparent
    # fill keeps the frame and loses the rectangle.
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = line),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = ink, color = ink),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = ink, color = ink),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, color = bone),
    plot.margin = unit(c(16, 28, 12, 20), "points")
  )

# The rank cell doubles as the bar: every leaderboard reads at a glance because
# the longest bar is the leader and one half as long is half the total.
bar_cell <- function(value, max_value, colour = wnba_orange) {
  width <- if (is.finite(max_value) && max_value > 0) {
    paste0(max(3, round(100 * value / max_value)), "%")
  } else {
    "0%"
  }
  div(
    style = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px",
    div(
      style = paste0(
        "flex:0 0 46px;height:8px;background:", panel_3, ";border-radius:2px"
      ),
      div(style = paste0(
        "width:", width, ";height:100%;background:", colour, ";border-radius:2px"
      ))
    ),
    span(style = "font-weight:600", format(value, big.mark = ","))
  )
}

# Sixteen near-identical thirty-line chunks collapsed to one call each. The
# eight leaderboards on a page are now eight tabs of a single card rather than
# eight cards spread over two rows, which is where the height for the player
# panels came from.
stat_card <- function(df, col, label) {
  top <- max(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)

  # `stat()` returns a `total_seasons` column for the career frames and omits it
  # for the single-season ones, and reactable rejects a colDef naming a column
  # that is not there. Build the list from what the frame actually has.
  cols <- list(
    rank = colDef(name = "#", maxWidth = sm, style = list(color = mute)),
    athlete = colDef(name = "Athlete", minWidth = 130),
    total_seasons = colDef(name = "Seasons", maxWidth = md),
    seasons = colDef(name = "Span", maxWidth = lg, style = list(color = mute))
  )
  cols <- cols[intersect(names(cols), names(df))]
  cols[[col]] <- colDef(
    name = label,
    minWidth = 140,
    cell = function(value) bar_cell(value, top)
  )

  df |>
    SharedData$new(key = ~athlete, group = "experience") |>
    reactable(
      compact = TRUE,
      highlight = TRUE,
      striped = TRUE,
      filterable = FALSE,
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      defaultSorted = list(rank = "asc"),
      theme = court_theme,
      columns = cols
    )
}
```

```{r teamcards}
#| title: "Fifteen teams · won-lost, points for and against, last ten"

# bslib walks this tag tree and stamps `html-fill-item html-fill-container` on
# every node, which turns each card and the row inside it into a column
# flexbox. The stylesheet answers that by scoping these rules under #standings,
# which outranks a single class; emitting the markup as text instead only
# traded the problem for pandoc reading htmltools' indentation as a code block.
div(
  id = "standings",
  pmap(
    standings,
    function(team_abbreviation, name, color, logo, w, l, pf, pa, form) {
      div(
        class = "tcard",
        style = paste0("--team:", color),
        div(
          class = "tc-top",
          if (is.na(logo)) NULL else tags$img(src = logo, alt = "", loading = "lazy"),
          span(class = "tc-name", name),
          span(class = "tc-rec", paste0(w, "\u2013", l))
        ),
        div(
          class = "tc-line",
          span(sprintf("%.0f for \u00b7 %.0f against", pf, pa)),
          span(class = "tc-form", map(form, \(r) tags$i(class = r)))
        )
      )
    }
  )
)
```
